name: lag_nvda_intraday_1d

name: lag_qqq_intraday_2d
meaning: QQQ's open-to-close return from two sessions ago. Intraday market strength shows a delayed spillover into Apple, so higher values point to up days.

name: msft_intraday_mean_3d

name: nvda_drawdown_20d_peer

name: msft_cum_return_2d
meaning: MSFT's two-day return. A short two-day rally in the mega-cap peer tends to be followed by consolidation, so higher values point to down days.

name: lag_nvda_overnight_gap_2d
meaning: NVDA's overnight gap from two sessions ago. Opening demand in the AI leader spills over into Apple with a short delay, so higher values point to up days.

name: aapl_range_mean_10d
meaning: Average Apple daily trading range over two weeks. Wider ranges reflect active trading and repricing that tends to resolve into up days, so higher values point to up days.

name: aapl_range_mean_20d
meaning: Average Apple daily trading range over a month. A monthly regime of wide daily swings tends to be followed by bounces, so higher values point to up days.

name: aapl_position_mean_5d
meaning: Average place of Apple's close inside its daily range over a week. Closes that keep finishing near the high show steady intraday buying that tends to continue, so higher values point to up days.

name: aapl_position_mean_20d
meaning: Average place of Apple's close inside its daily range over a month. A persistent tendency to finish strong signals accumulation that tends to continue, so higher values point to up days.

name: aapl_high5_dist
meaning: How far Apple's close sits below its five-day high. Being right at the recent high means a stretched move that tends to pause, so a value nearer zero points to down days.

name: aapl_low5_dist
meaning: How far Apple's close sits above its five-day low. Closes far off recent lows signal an extended bounce that tends to give back gains, so higher values point to down days.

name: aapl_intraday_mean_10d

name: aapl_overnight_gap_mean_10d

name: zscore_aapl_overnight_gap_20d

name: aapl_volume_change_5d

name: aapl_volume_ma5_vs_ma60

name: aapl_volume_zscore_60d

name: zscore_aapl_return_20d

name: zscore_aapl_return_60d

name: aapl_abs_return_mean_5d

name: aapl_abs_return_mean_20d

name: aapl_sign_return_mean_10d

name: aapl_upper_wick_mean_5d

name: aapl_lower_wick_mean_5d

name: aapl_open_close_sign_3d

name: zscore_aapl_range_60d

name: lag2_aapl_return_1d

name: aapl_cum_return_3d
meaning: Apple's three-day return. A sharp three-day rally tends to be faded in the short run as traders take profit, so higher values point to down days.

name: aapl_return_2d_sum

name: aapl_volatility_3d
